description: Map the relation graph around one DOI — versions, parts, supplements, derivations, documentation, citations, references, and every other DataCite relation type — as nodes and directed edges that keep the relationType exactly as asserted and name each edge's source: the DOI's own metadata, other DataCite records that point at it, or DataCite Event Data (citation links harvested from Crossref and other sources). Accepts any DOI, including a journal article's DOI, to find the datasets and software it cites and those that cite, supplement, or derive from it. DataCite DOIs are hydrated with title, type, year, repository, and citation count; other identifiers stay leaf nodes. Depth 1 by default, at most 2, with a node cap (default 50, max 100) disclosed when it binds. An absent edge is not evidence that no relationship exists.

depth.description: Hops from the root: 1 (default) or 2. Depth 2 expands at most 10 DataCite neighbours through their own and reverse metadata, and runs only while max_nodes has room after the first hop.

doi.description: The root DOI — any agency's, e.g. a DataCite dataset 10.5061/dryad.234 or a journal article's DOI. Bare, doi:, or a doi.org URL; case-insensitive.

event_offset.description: Absolute zero-based Event Data position, 0–9,999. Presence, including 0, selects Event-Data-only mode: no metadata edges or depth-2 expansion. Reads one 100-event upstream page, starting within it. Continue with coverage.eventData.nextEventOffset and the same doi and filters; ordering can change between calls, so this is not a snapshot.

include_event_data.description: Add Event Data citation links (mostly harvested from Crossref). Citation relation types only.

max_nodes.description: Requested node cap including the root, 1–10,000 (default 50); values above 100 apply 100 with a notice. Filled in order: own-metadata targets, records pointing at the root, Event Data endpoints, then the second hop.

relation_types.description: Only these relation types (IsVersionOf, HasPart, IsSupplementTo, IsDerivedFrom, Cites, IsCitedBy, …), any case, read from the traced DOI's side: HasPart keeps the DOI's own HasPart assertions and the records asserting IsPartOf it, each edge shown as asserted. IsPublishedIn and Other have no inverse and match on either side. A second hop reads them from each expanded neighbour's side. Omitted: all. Groups: datacite_list_reference topic relation_types.

name: datacite_trace_relations

coverage.description: What each source contributed and how much of it was read.

detail.description: Why Event Data was skipped or unavailable.

hasNextPage.description: Whether the returned upstream links contain next; does not override totals or the ranked ceiling.

kept.description: Default mode: qualifying events before max_nodes applies. Event-Data-only mode: raw events represented in returned edges, duplicates included. For a non-DataCite root, only confirmed DataCite objects are kept.

nextEventOffset.description: Next raw event to examine with the same DOI and filters. A blocked position retries here; max_nodes=1 requires raising max_nodes first. Absent on exhaustion, a skipped/unavailable page, or the 10,000-result ceiling.

offset.description: Requested absolute raw-event offset, present in Event-Data-only mode.

page.description: Upstream page returned, or requested when upstream omits it.

progress.description: Continuation state: more raw events, exhausted matching results, the 10,000-ranked-result ceiling, or an uncertain endpoint lookup that must be retried.

scope.description: both_sides for a DataCite root; outgoing_to_datacite for any other root.

status.description: ok, skipped (disabled or no citation types), or unavailable (did not answer).

edgeCount.description: Relations the root's own record asserts (after relation_types).

status.description: not_datacite when DataCite holds no record for the root; skipped in event_offset mode.

reverseMetadata.description: Other DataCite records pointing at the root.

fetched.description: Records this call read: at most 100, or the first 10 when those list over 10,000 related identifiers between them.

secondHop.description: Other DataCite records pointing at the second-hop frontier; present only when a second hop ran.

fetched.description: Records this call read of them: at most 100, or the first 10 when those list over 10,000 related identifiers between them.

total.description: Records matching the second hop's reverse query upstream.

status.description: skipped in event_offset mode; otherwise a reverse query that does not answer fails the whole call.

total.description: Records matching the reverse query upstream.

edges.description: Edges between returned nodes, at most 1,000, the first found; identical edges from several sources are merged.

eventSources.description: Event Data source-id values, e.g. crossref, datacite-crossref.

from.description: The asserting side (node id): the record whose metadata states the relation, or the subject of an Event Data link.

relationType.description: Relation type exactly as asserted by from — never inverted.

sources.description: How the edge was reached. metadata and reverse_metadata both read from's own relatedIdentifiers and relatedItems — metadata by reading that record, reverse_metadata by querying for records that point at to — so an edge listing both is one assertion reached twice, not two confirmations; event_data is a link harvested by Event Data, independent of either.

edgesFound.description: Edges between the returned nodes before the 1,000-edge cap; present only when the cap bound.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_doi`: The root is not a DOI after normalization. `rate_limited`: This deployment's shared DataCite request budget is spent: its request queue could not start a request before the call's deadline, or DataCite answered HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

citationCount.description: Citations DataCite records for this DOI.

hydrated.description: Whether title/type/year came back for this node.

id.description: Identifier: a lowercase bare DOI, or any other identifier verbatim.

idType.description: DOI, URL, arXiv, PMID, Handle, ISSN, IGSN, …: the related-identifier type deposited (a doi.org URL counts as DOI), or Unknown when none was deposited.

isDataCiteDoi.description: DOIs only: true for a DataCite-registered DOI, false for another agency's DOI DataCite holds a linking copy of; absent when DataCite returned nothing for it.

notice.description: Coverage caveats: non-DataCite root, no relations found, Event Data unavailable, records pointing at a DOI too large to read 100 of, Event Data objects left out and nodes left unhydrated because DataCite did not answer in time, node cap, unexpanded second hop, neighbours past the second-hop limit, edge cap, uncounted citations.

root.description: The root DOI. For another agency's DOI, title, type, and year come from DataCite's linking copy when it holds one.

isDataCiteDoi.description: Whether DataCite holds a public record for the root.

rootCounts.description: DataCite's own counts for the root (DataCite roots only), to compare with the edges shown.

citationCount.description: Citations DataCite records for the root.

partOfCount.description: DOIs the root is part of.

versionOfCount.description: DOIs the root is a version of.

truncated.description: True when max_nodes or the 1,000-edge cap bound.

title: Trace DataCite relations
